name: command-palette
description: Cmd+K style command palette with lexical search, sectioned results and full keyboard navigation
designIntent: AI-assisted and power-user apps expose many actions; a command palette keeps them all one keystroke away. The palette is a combobox+listbox with aria-activedescendant navigation so focus never leaves the input, filters lexically over labels/sections/keywords, and reports selection through a single callback.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the user opens or dismisses the palette

props.name: commands
props.description: Available commands: { id, label, section?, keywords?, shortcut? }

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Invoked with the chosen command before the palette closes

examples.title: Wired to Cmd+K
examples.description: Toggle the palette with Cmd/Ctrl+K and run the selected command.

antiPatterns.title: Do not use the palette as a text editor command
antiPatterns.explanation: The palette searches discrete commands. For AI chat input use PromptInput instead.

accessibility.implementation: The input uses role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant and aria-autocomplete=list.
Arrow keys cycle options, Enter selects, Escape closes; focus never leaves the input.
Each result is role=option with aria-selected marking the active item.

compositionRules.relationship: CommandPalette switches modes/actions; PromptInput captures free-form chat text.
